embeds.title: 🚀 NEXORA v3.5.0-PRO IS OFFICIALLY HERE!
embeds.description:
**The next evolution of your Discord experience!** 🌌

NEXORA v3.5.0-PRO brings Discord DMs and User Apps, interactive giveaways, competitive leaderboards, automated birthday celebrations, and major performance improvements.

Here's what's new! 👇

fields.name: 📱 1. NEXORA — Available Everywhere
fields.value:
Install NEXORA directly to your Discord account!

• 33 curated commands available in DMs and Group DMs.
• Play `/rps`, `/tictactoe`, `/connect4`, `/guess`.
• Use `/avatar`, `/userinfo`, `/calc`, `/remind`, `/meme` and `/ship`.
• Server moderation and administration remain server-only.

fields.name: 🎁 2. Interactive Giveaway Engine
fields.value:
**Setup:** `/giveaway` or `n!giveaway`
• Interactive channel and role selection.
• Modal-based configuration.
• Quick launch: `n!gstart 1h Discord Nitro`.

**Live controls:** 🎉 Enter • 👥 Participants • 🛑 End Early • 🎲 Reroll Winner

MongoDB Atlas and RAM caching support giveaway recovery after restarts.

embeds.title: 🏆 COMPETE. CELEBRATE. PLAY.
embeds.description: Discover the interactive features powering your NEXORA experience.

fields.name: 🏆 3. Interactive Game Leaderboards
fields.value:
Use `/gamestats`, `n!leaderboard` or `n!lb` to view the Top 10 rankings.

Categories: Overall, Tic-Tac-Toe, Connect Four, Rock-Paper-Scissors and Number Guesser.

Switch between 🏰 Server Rankings and 🌍 Global Rankings.

fields.name: 🎂 4. Midnight Birthday System
fields.value:
Automated birthday announcements at **00:00 midnight**, based on each server's configured timezone.

Setup: `/introbdsetup` or `n!bdaysetup`.

Configure announcement channels, introduction channels, timezone offsets and birthday roles. Includes duplicate-announcement protection.

fields.name: 🎮 5. Infinite Rematches & Cleaner Notifications
fields.value:
Play Again / Rematch creates fresh sessions for RPS, Tic-Tac-Toe, Connect Four and Number Guesser.

Turn alerts reply directly to game boards, while previous notifications are cleaned up to keep chats tidy.

footer.text: NEXORA • More ways to compete and connect

embeds.title: ⚡ MORE POWER. MORE INTERACTION.
embeds.description: Social features and performance improvements in one major upgrade.

fields.name: 🥊 6. Action Retaliation & Discord User Apps
fields.value:
Commands such as `n!hug`, `n!slap` and `n!punch` now support interactive retaliation.

• Click **{Action} Back!** to retaliate.
• Continue chains and track live interaction streaks.

**User Apps:** Right-click a user → Apps → Ship With Me or View Avatar & Banner.

fields.name: ⚡ 7. Faster Engine & Hot Reloading
fields.value:
Optimized in-memory caching for AFK, reminders, action commands and mini-games.

Use `n!owner` for the owner panel or `n!reload` to apply supported updates without a complete bot restart.

fields.name: 🌌 THE NEXT CHAPTER STARTS NOW!
fields.value:
Run `/help` or `n!help` to explore the updated commands and features.

Thank you for being part of the NEXORA community! ❤️

**— Team NEXORA**

footer.text: NEXORA v3.5.0-PRO • Your Discord. Your Experience. Your NEXORA. 🚀
